description_en: Queries the aggregate routes in the route table of an Enterprise Edition transit router
description_zh: 查询企业版转发路由器路由表下的聚合路由
kebab_example: aliyun cbn describe-transit-route-table-aggregation --transit-route-table-id vtb-6ehgc262hr170qgyc0000 --transit-route-table-aggregation-cidr 192.168.10.0/24 --client-token 02fb3da4-130e-11e9-8e44-0010000 --max-results 20 --next-token FFmyTO70tTpLG6I3FmYAXGKPd0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeTransitRouteTableAggregation

parameters.help_en: The ID of the route table of the Enterprise Edition transit router
parameters.help_zh: 企业版转发路由器路由表ID
parameters.name: transit_route_table_id

parameters.help_en: The destination CIDR block of the aggregate route
parameters.name: transit_route_table_aggregation_cidr

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a token from your client to ensure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the request as the ClientToken. The RequestId is different for each request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。默认值：20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Valid values:

You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request.

You must specify the token that is obtained from the previous query as the value of NextToken
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：

第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token
